patch.description: Update plan lifecycle or per-command progress, or build/revise a still-proposed plan: decisions, appendStep (+insertAt), editStep, removeStep, title/overview, cost, and risk fields. Content revisions are rejected once the plan is approved.

value.description: Short chosen value. Keep this compact for an approval card. Do not paste logs, YAML/JSON manifests, heredocs, diffs, or long prose here; summarize and defer bulky detail to execution.

decisions.description: Replace the decisions section: key choices the user should review.

title.description: Short step title, usually 3-8 words. Required on the step itself — the top-level label field is transient UI status text, not the step title.

description.description: One concise sentence. Keep this compact for an approval card. Do not paste logs, YAML/JSON manifests, heredocs, diffs, or long prose here; summarize and defer bulky detail to execution.

command.description: Short executable command only. Avoid heredocs, inline YAML/JSON, base64, generated files, or giant one-liners. If the real work needs bulky content, create/reference a file during execution instead of embedding it in plan_create.

description.description: One concise sentence. Keep this compact for an approval card. Do not paste logs, YAML/JSON manifests, heredocs, diffs, or long prose here; summarize and defer bulky detail to execution.

commands.description: Use only the commands needed for approval. Prefer a few short commands over many detailed variants; defer verbose setup to execution.

jobs.description: Keep the approval card small: usually 1-3 jobs per step. Split or defer detail instead of listing every low-level operation.

appendStep.description: Add one execution step. Send one step per request, in order.

insertAt.description: 0-based position to insert appendStep at; omit to append at the end.

get.description: Lists database connections visible to the team member. Credentials are never returned.

post.description: Tests and stores an encrypted MongoDB or PostgreSQL connection.
Tests credentials without persisting or returning the connection URI.

get.description: Returns redacted database metadata only.

patch.description: Updates metadata, policy, or tested encrypted credentials.

delete.description: Permanently deletes a database connection and its encrypted credential.

post.description: Decrypts only on the backend, runs a health check, and persists the redacted result.

get.description: Lists authorized MongoDB databases through the backend credential boundary.
Lists collections and bounded statistics for one authorized database.
Returns indexes, validation metadata, and a bounded value-free schema sample.

post.summary: Run a bounded MongoDB read query
post.description: Executes an allowlisted read operation through the audited backend gateway. Credentials and raw database errors are never returned.

get.description: Returns query audit metadata with a bounded, sanitized statement. Raw request bodies, sensitive query values, result values, and credentials are never stored.
Returns bounded, value-only MongoDB process metrics. Credentials, query text, current operations, and raw command responses are never stored.

post.description: Collects one allowlisted MongoDB metrics snapshot through the backend credential boundary. Calls are rate-limited per connection.

get.description: Lists team-scoped MongoDB DML/DDL requests with approval and execution state.

post.description: Encrypts an executable MongoDB statement and creates a team-scoped draft. Credentials and raw statements are never logged.

get.description: Returns a sanitized statement preview, approval state, authorized executors, and audit timeline.

patch.summary: Update a draft database change request
patch.description: Only the requester can edit a draft. Execution semantics are immutable after submission.

post.description: Submits the immutable statement digest for team approval.
Records one distinct team-member approval. Approval does not grant execution authority or execute the request.
Rejects the pending request without executing it.
Cancels a draft, pending, or approved request without executing it.

post.summary: Execute an approved database change request
post.description: Only an explicitly authorized executor can claim and execute the approved immutable statement through the backend gateway.

post.summary: Report a Nuphos bug or request a feature
post.description: Public, unauthenticated. Any person or agent that hits a problem using Nuphos, or misses a capability, can file it here. Reports are recorded for the Nuphos team to triage by hand. Rate limited per client; 429 means retry later.

type.description: `bug` for a defect, `feature` for a request.

description.description: What happened or what is wanted: steps, expected vs actual behavior, error output. Never include secrets, tokens, or private data.

source.description: Optional reporter identifier, e.g. the agent or client name and version.
